claims.value: Possibly one of the 'two Virgin Marys' begun in 1478
claims.statement: The identification of this panel with one of the two Madonnas Leonardo noted as begun in 1478 (a dated inscription on a Uffizi drawing, number to locate) is a scholarly identification, not a documented fact. The inscription text and its number were not checked in this session.
